# Rentail.space

> Rentail.space is a specialty lease marketplace that helps businesses find short-term retail spaces in shopping centers. We connect businesses looking for temporary retail locations with property owners who have available spaces.


## Features

- AI-powered space discovery and matching
- Short-term lease opportunities
- Shopping center focus
- Business-to-business marketplace


## Executive Summary

The retail landscape is experiencing its most significant transformation in decades—and smart operators are capitalizing on unprecedented opportunities.

Specialty retail is exploding at 11.8% CAGR, reaching $68.4 billion in 2025, while big box retailers hemorrhage customer satisfaction. This represents a $2.3 trillion opportunity for agile retailers who understand the fundamental shift happening in consumer behavior.


## The Numbers That Matter

* 55% of consumers prefer specialty stores for unique products
* 47% discover new products at specialty retailers
* 46% struggle finding specific items at big box stores
* 80% demand personalized retail experiences
* 73% want personalized rewards programs

Environmental consciousness and authenticity demands are driving customers to specialty retailers. The second-hand fashion market alone will grow 127% by 2026.

Strategic Insight: Big box stores built their empire on scale—but scale creates rigidity. Specialty retailers win through agility and personalization.

If you've built successful Etsy operations, you've already validated product-market fit. 80% of retail sales still happen offline—your proven online success gives you massive competitive advantages over traditional retailers.

The specialty retail revolution is creating unprecedented opportunities for agile operators. Your online success proves you understand customers and products. The physical retail expansion multiplies that success through strategic execution.
